title: [Data]: Add DSA Sheet — Two Pointers & Sliding Window
body:
## 📋 Task Description

PrepPilot currently has limited DSA sheets. We need a dedicated sheet for **Two Pointers & Sliding Window** problems, which are among the most frequently tested patterns in coding interviews.

## ✅ What needs to be done

- Create a new JSON file at `backend/sheets/two-pointers-sliding-window.json`
- Follow the exact schema used in existing sheets (see `backend/sheets/arrays-practice.json` as reference)
- Include at least **20–30 subtopics** covering classic problems (e.g. Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters, Container With Most Water, etc.)
- Add difficulty levels: `easy`, `medium`, `hard`
- Include `gfg`, `leetcode`, and `youtube` links for each problem where available
- Run `node backend/seedSheets.js` to verify the sheet loads correctly

## 📁 Reference File

See `backend/sheets/arrays-practice.json` for the expected JSON structure.

## 🙋 Good For

Contributors familiar with DSA who want to help grow the learning content.

title: [Data]: Collect Free Certifications — Cloud Computing (AWS, GCP, Azure)
body:
## 📋 Task Description

The Free Courses section in PrepPilot needs more free certification resources for Cloud Computing platforms. Many valuable free certs are not yet listed.

## ✅ What needs to be done

- Add new entries to `backend/data/allcourses.json` and `frontend/src/data/allcourses.json` under the relevant categories (`AWS`, `Cloud Computing`)
- Collect **free certification courses** from platforms like:
  - AWS Skill Builder (free tier)
  - Google Cloud Skills Boost (free labs)
  - Microsoft Learn (AZ-900 learning paths)
  - IBM SkillsBuild
- Each entry must include: `name`, `source`, `link`, and an appropriate `icon`
- Verify links are active and genuinely free

## 📁 Reference

See existing entries in `backend/data/allcourses.json` for the required JSON format.

## ⚠️ Rules

- Only add courses that are **completely free** (no credit card required)
- No referral or affiliate links

title: [Game]: Build a Memory Card Matching Game for Cognitive Training
body:
## 📋 Task Description

PrepPilot has a Cognitive Games section (`/cognitive-games`) to help users build cognitive skills. We need a new **Memory Card Matching Game**.

## ✅ What needs to be done

- Create a new React component at `frontend/src/components/MemoryCardGame.jsx`
- Game rules: Show a grid of face-down cards; user flips two at a time; matched pairs stay revealed; goal is to match all pairs in minimum moves
- Cards can show DSA concept names, algorithm names, or tech logos to make it relevant to interview prep
- Show: moves count, timer, and a win screen when all pairs matched
- Follow the existing game card style from `CognitiveGamesPage.jsx`
- Register the game in `CognitiveGamesPage.jsx`

## 📁 Reference

`frontend/src/components/GridMemoryGame.jsx` and `frontend/src/pages/CognitiveGames/CognitiveGamesPage.jsx`

title: [Game]: Build a Typing Speed Challenge Game for Focus Training
body:
## 📋 Task Description

Add a **Typing Speed Challenge** game to the Cognitive Games section. Typing speed is a practical skill for coding interviews and tests focus/concentration.

## ✅ What needs to be done

- Create `frontend/src/components/TypingSpeedGame.jsx`
- Display a random paragraph (can use DSA/CS-related sentences or code snippets)
- Track: WPM (words per minute), accuracy %, time elapsed
- Highlight correct characters in green, incorrect in red as the user types
- Show results screen with WPM, accuracy, and option to retry
- Register the game in `CognitiveGamesPage.jsx`

## 📁 Reference

`frontend/src/pages/CognitiveGames/CognitiveGamesPage.jsx`

title: [Resume]: Add Complete LaTeX Code for Jake's Resume Template

title: [Game]: Build a Code Output Prediction Game for Interview Prep
body:
## 📋 Task Description

Add a **Code Output Prediction** game to the Cognitive Games section. This directly trains a key interview skill — reading code and predicting output.

## ✅ What needs to be done

- Create `frontend/src/components/CodeOutputGame.jsx`
- Show a short code snippet (JavaScript or Python, 5–10 lines) and ask the user to predict the output
- Provide 4 multiple-choice options
- 10 questions per round with a 30-second timer per question
- Score tracking with explanation shown after each answer
- Questions can be stored as a static array in the component covering: closures, loops, type coercion, recursion basics
- Register in `CognitiveGamesPage.jsx`

## 📁 Reference

`frontend/src/pages/CognitiveGames/CognitiveGamesPage.jsx`
